buildCommand: cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @soie/db generate && (if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then echo '► DATABASE_URL set → running migrate + seed'; pnpm --filter @soie/db migrate:deploy && pnpm --filter @soie/db seed; else echo '► DATABASE_URL not set → skipping migrate/seed (site builds anyway)'; fi) && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@soie/web
